title: The Boy And The Beast Is Getting A 4K Blu-Ray Release Soon
description: The Boy and the Beast Limited-Edition Steelbook 4K Blu-ray $37 | Releases March 17 Preorder at Amazon The Boy and the Beast (Blu-ray) $27 | Releases March 17 Preorder at Amazon Anime fans looking to complete their collection of Mamoru Hosoda-directed steelbooks are in luck, as The Boy and the Beast is getting a new 4K Blu-ray release later this year. Priced at $37 ahead of its March 17 release--and $27 for the standard Blu-ray version-- the film tells a touching story about a master and his student as they learn from each other and join forces to repel a sinister threat. This version of the film will be sold exclusively through Amazon. The Boy and the Beast Limited-Edition Steelbook 4K Blu-ray $37 | Releases March 17 This new Blu-ray edition of The Boy and the Beast features artwork of the protagonists as they train on a rooftop during a Shibuya sunset. Bonus materials for this release include a "Making of The Boy and the Beast" featurette, promotional videos, cast and crew commentary tracks, and a collection of trailers. The Boy and the Beast special features Making of The Boy and the Beast Promotional video collection Cast commentary Key staff commentary Teasers and trailers Preorder at Amazon The Boy and the Beast (Blu-ray) $27 | Releases March 17 The Boy and the Beast will also be available as a new standard Blu-ray release. This version includes all of the extras above, and a different cover that features the protagonists Kyuta and Kumatetsu training together. Preorder at Amazon Released in 2015, The Boy and the Beast tells the story of Kyuta, a young boy living on the streets of Shibuya, after he is taken in by Kumatetsu, a rough-around-the-edges warrior from the Beast Kingdom who has been searching for an apprentice. Despite their differences and bickering, the duo quickly bonds during their training sessions and learn from each other. When an evil force arises, the pair's bond is put to the ultimate test as the fate of the world hangs in the balance. The movie was a box-office hit and the second film produced by Hosoda's fledgling animation company, Studio Chizu. Almost all of Hosoda's other films have gotten 4K steelbook releases recently, so if you're looking to dive into expertly crafted anime movies that blend emotional storytelling with fantasy, you can pick these up for a pretty good price currently. The Girl Who Leapt Through Time put Hosoda on the map with its powerful story of time travel and teenage drama, and you can pick it up for just $34 (was $37). Continue Reading at GameSpot

title: Forza Horizon 5 Is By Far Xbox's Most Successful Port On PS5 - Report
description: In 2025, Microsoft paved the way for the top Xbox franchises to make the leap to Sony's PlayStation 5. Now, a report suggests that there was clear winner among the Xbox ports: Forza Horizon 5, which hit PS5 four years after its debut. Despite that gap, it reportedly outsold the next four Xbox on PS5 games even when their sales totals were combined. Alinea Analytics has shared its breakdown of the top 5 best-selling Xbox games for PS5 in 2025. Forza Horizon 5 led the list with 5.1 million, followed by Gears of War Reloaded in a distant second place with 572,000 copies. Coming in third with 491,000 copies was Indiana Jones and the Great Circle, while Flight Simulator came for a landing at fourth with 166,000 copies. Senua's Saga Hellblade 2 rounded out the top five with 50,000 in sales. According to Alinea, there was only a single PS5 console-exclusive game that outsold Forza Horizon 5 in 2025. That title was Marvel's Spider-Man 2, which moved 5.2 million copies on PlayStation 5 last year. Continue Reading at GameSpot

title: Marvel Rivals' Deadpool Can Literally Do It All
description: Deadpool is coming to Marvel Rivals alongside Season 6 on January 16, and in a first for the hero shooter, he will be able to play any role he chooses--Duelist, Vanguard, or Strategist. As explained by Deadpool himself in the Marvel Rivals Dev Vision video, he's heard the community's "non-stop complaining online about how the game needs more Vanguards and Strategists," so he decided to do the NetEase development team a favor and just be all three roles. title: CoD: Black Ops 7 And Warzone Patch Notes Detail Nerfs For OP Guns
description: A small update has arrived to Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 and Warzone on January 13, and the patch notes reveal a focus on weapon balancing for Season 1 Reloaded. This includes a nerf for the akimbo variant of the Velox 5.7 pistol in Warzone, and the Maddox RFB assault rifle now has decreased damage ranges in multiplayer and Zombies. For multiplayer and Zombies, the patch notes detail major adjustments for the Maddox RFB assault rifle. This includes a reduction to movement speed, added recoil, and significant decreases to the gun's damage range. The developer says the Maddox RFB has been very strong because of its quick time-to-kill in close quarters, but the controllable recoil let it stretch its effectiveness out to longer ranges than intended. "We'd like to keep the close-range damage high, as that was core to the weapon's identity in Black Ops 4," Treyarch says. "It has received significant range and recoil nerfs to reduce its versatility." Continue Reading at GameSpot

title: How AGDQ Pulled Off A 70-Person Super Mario 64 Speedrun
description: Collaborative challenges aren't a brand-new concept for Games Done Quick--the twice-yearly speedrunning charity event--but KingJO444 took things just a little bit further for Awesome Games Done Quick 2026. On January 10 in Pittsburgh, he gathered a group of 70 players together to attempt an absurdly chaotic challenge: Collect 70 stars in Super Mario 64 with 70 different players. Somehow, he and the community were successful, completing the challenge in under two hours. It wasn't an easy feat to come up with an estimated time for the run, at all, because of the 70 people who participated--each getting exactly one star before passing off the controller--only between 15-20 had any serious experience running the game. Of the remaining players, some had not played Super Mario 64 since childhood, and others had never played the game at all. "You never know how much someone's going to practice, or what's going to happen on stage," KingJ told us in a post-run interview. He set the estimated time to complete the run at an hour and 40 minutes, but this was only slightly longer than the current world record. Continue Reading at GameSpot

title: Sophie Turner Discusses Tomb Raider TV Show And Her Intense Training For It
description: Sophie Turner will play Lara Croft in the upcoming Tomb Raider TV series on Prime Video, and now the Game of Thrones star has further discussed the series, including how she's preparing. Appearing on SiriusXM, Turner started off by confirming she's never met Angelina Jolie, who played Croft in a pair of Tomb Raider movies in the early 2000s. "No. Never. I would love to meet her," she said. As for her preparation for the series, Turner said she's playing the video games and reading the comics, but she is purposefully avoiding the Jolie movies. "I don't want to imitate. I've got to create my own thing. So as much as I love those movies, I can't watch them right now," she said. Continue Reading at GameSpot
